name: Nutritionist — asks about the concern first, then answers with herb cards

planSteps.description: Click the starter prompt button 'How do I get better sleep?'
A user message bubble containing 'How do I get better sleep?' appears and the starter prompt buttons are no longer shown
Wait up to 90 seconds for the assistant reply to finish typing

Right now, before sending any other message: the first assistant reply asks the user at least one question about their sleep, and the conversation area shows no herb cards (no cards with a '% match' badge)

Only after the previous check is done, type 'I wake up around 3am most nights with racing thoughts and can't get back to sleep. It has been about a month and I'm exhausted at work most days. I am not on any medications and not pregnant.' into the message textarea and press Enter
Wait up to 120 seconds for the second assistant reply to finish typing
A second assistant message with at least one sentence of text is shown below the second user message
At least one herb card is shown below the second assistant message, with a herb name heading and a '% match' badge
A 'New chat' button is visible in the page header

description: The nutritionist first asks about a vague sleep concern without showing any herb cards (diagnosis), then, once the user has answered its questions, replies with recommendations and herb cards (treatment).
